description:
At PMAT, we work on mission critical systems that directly support the warfighter, designing, building, and securing modern digital capabilities across cloud, data, and software environments. Our teams tackle complex, real-world challenges where delivery matters more than theory, and innovation is driven by curiosity, collaboration, and purpose.

  

 In this role, you’ll contribute to Naval Operational Architecture (NOA), working alongside engineers and operators to deliver resilient, forward-leaning solutions in support of national defense.

 


 About the role: PMAT is seeking a MSS Developer to design, develop, and enhance user-facing applications and visualizations within the MSS and Palantir Foundry environments. This role focuses on translating complex data, operational requirements, and end-user feedback into intuitive dashboards, interactive interfaces, and effective data visualization solutions. The candidate will work closely with Foundry developers, data engineers, analysts, and operational stakeholders to improve the usability, readability, accessibility, and consistency of Slate applications and other Foundry-based products. The role requires strong UI/UX design skills, hands-on development capabilities, and the ability to rapidly iterate on solutions that support mission-focused decision-making.

 


 Responsibilities: 

 
 Design, develop, and enhance user interfaces, dashboards, and interactive visualizations within MSS and Palantir Foundry, with an emphasis on usability and operational effectiveness.

 Build and refine Foundry Slate applications by improving layouts, navigation, data presentation, readability, and overall user experience.

 Collaborate with data engineers, developers, analysts, and operational stakeholders to translate requirements and complex data workflows into intuitive, user-friendly applications.

 Gather, evaluate, and incorporate end-user feedback to continuously improve application functionality, visualization effectiveness, and user experience.

 Develop reusable UI components, templates, design patterns, and guidance to promote consistency and accelerate development across Foundry products.

 Apply accessibility, responsive design, and usability principles to ensure applications support diverse users, workflows, and operational environments.

 Support frontend development and integration activities by connecting user interfaces with Foundry Ontology objects, data pipelines, APIs, and supporting application services.

 Test, troubleshoot, document, and maintain UI/UX solutions while collaborating with development teams to resolve issues and implement enhancements.

 
  

 About Us: PMAT is an innovative small business founded with a passion for developing forward-leaning solutions from exceptional people that increase the mission's capability. We focus on designing and building impactful digital solutions that utilize modern cloud, data, and software concepts. Our passion is working on complex and progressive challenges such as edge platform computing, containerizing legacy platforms, distributed data platforms, or heterogeneous data analysis.

  

 We recruit, retain, and foster a team motivated to pursue passions, investigate new ways of doing things, and embody an innovative and entrepreneurial spirit. We believe in being curious about every element of a problem and experiment relentlessly. We foster continuous learning in an environment that encourages positive collaboration and expands our capabilities. We tap into collective intelligence, acknowledging that the most brilliant people may not be in the room.  Above all else, we believe that delivering and demonstrating is more potent than a sheet of paper.  We are passionate about mission-centric design and delivering effective capabilities to and for the warfighter.

  

 Whether you’re an experienced engineer or just beginning your career, you’ll work alongside experts who are committed to solving mission-critical problems. If you’re passionate about using your skills to make a real difference, apply today and become part of a team that’s shaping the future of defense technology!

 


 Required Skills and Experience: 

 
 Experience designing and developing user interfaces, dashboards, data visualizations, or interactive web applications.

 Experience developing applications or user-facing capabilities within MSS, Palantir Foundry, or similar enterprise data and application development environments.

 Experience applying UI/UX design principles, including usability, information architecture, accessibility, visual hierarchy, and consistent interface design.

 Experience with frontend development technologies, component-based application design, and modern web development practices.

 Ability to translate complex data, technical requirements, and operational workflows into clear, intuitive, and actionable visual experiences.

 Experience collaborating with end-users and cross-functional technical teams to gather requirements, incorporate feedback, and iteratively improve applications.

 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify and resolve usability and application issues.

 Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain design decisions and technical concepts to developers, analysts, program stakeholders, and operational users.

 
  

 Preferred Skills and Experience: 

 
 Hands-on experience developing and maintaining Palantir Foundry Slate applications, custom widgets, dashboards, and visualization products.

 Experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, React, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS, or related frontend development technologies.

 Experience integrating Foundry Ontology objects, data pipelines, APIs, and application services into user-facing applications.

 Experience with data visualization libraries, interactive charting, geospatial visualization, or advanced dashboard development.

 Experience creating reusable component libraries, design systems, application templates, and UI/UX development standards.

 Familiarity with object-oriented programming, Python, SQL, Git, and full-stack software development concepts.

 Experience conducting usability testing, gathering operational user feedback, and refining applications through iterative development.

 Experience supporting Navy, Department of War, government, or other mission-focused data and software environments.

 
 


 Education and Certification Requirements: 

 Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent Experience

 


 Citizenship and Clearance Requirements:  

 
 S. Citizenship required

 No dual citizenship

 
 
 SECRET security clearance required

 TS/(SCI Eligible) a plus

 
 


 Location/Address: 

 
 100% On-site

 San Diego, CA, NAVWAR

 
 


 Travel & Passport: 5 %, CONUS and OCONUS

 


 Work Environment: PMAT offices as needed. In some cases, work in a government facility may be required. Travel may be required for customer engagement, team coordination, and potentially for business development.

 


 PMAT is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe in hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive, people-first culture. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, such as disability and veteran status, or any other basis covered under applicable law.
